description: Content moderation: is a user comment abusive toward a person or group (not merely negative or profane).

toxic.instructions: Is this comment abusive: does it insult, demean, threaten or harass an identifiable person or group? Name-calling or slurs aimed at someone count even when framed through their work. Hyperbolic criticism of a performance, product or idea, and profanity not aimed at anyone, do not count.

criteria.true: Insults, threatens, demeans or harasses a person or group
criteria.false: Not abusive, even if negative or crude

cases.state: I've played this game since launch and I have to say patch 4.2 is a complete dumpster fire. The new matchmaking puts level 10 players against people with a thousand hours, the loading times on console have doubled, and the crafting rework turned a fun system into a grind that feels designed to sell boosters. Half the maps now have invisible walls in places where you could walk last week. What the hell happened to playtesting? The worst part is the patch notes didn't mention half of these changes, so we all found out the hard way during ranked. I'm not asking for miracles. Roll back the matchmaking, fix the loading, and give us the old crafting costs until you figure out something better. Until then I'm uninstalling, and judging by the reviews this week I'm not the only one. Such a shame, because the art and music in this update are honestly the best they've ever been.
cases.rationale: Harsh, profane criticism of a patch and its process, with no person or group insulted.

cases.state: Thanks to everyone who came to the allotment association meeting on Thursday. For those who missed it: the water will be shut off for winter on 1 November, so please drain your hoses before then, and the shed key now lives in the lockbox by the gate, code from the board on request. We also agreed to buy a second wheelbarrow and to repaint the compost bins in spring, volunteers welcome. On the hedge dispute, the board voted to keep the current rules. And to Brian on plot 14, who stood up and shouted at the treasurer for ten minutes: you are a nasty, small little man and everybody on this allotment is sick of you. If you ever raise your voice at Karen again, you'll be the one needing a new set of teeth, and I'll be happy to oblige. See you all at the harvest dinner on the 18th, bring a dish to share.
cases.rationale: Mostly neutral notice that insults and threatens an identifiable person (Brian on plot 14).
